title: Melange: Cost Efficient Large Language Model Serving by Exploiting GPU Heterogeneity
technique: GPU-type allocation as cost-aware bin packing (ILP) over workload slices (request size, rate) with per-GPU profiled capacity under a TPOT SLO; mixes heterogeneous GPUs

optimized_metrics.evidence: our objective is to provision GPUs that can minimize deployment cost while adhering to latency SLO constraints.
We define SLO based on average TPOT, however, Mélange can be extended to other definitions of SLO such as time to first token (TTFT).
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: We define SLO based on average TPOT

headline_claim.text: Compared to using only a single GPU type, Mélange reduces deployment costs by up to 77% in conversational settings, 33% in document-based settings, and 51% in a mixed setting.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 11 ($/hr vs request rate, per dataset/SLO)
§6.3 Fig 12 TPOT CDFs (99.5% at 40 ms, 99.95% at 120 ms)
profiled max request rate per GPU at SLO (§5.3)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we use the average Time Per Output Token (TPOT) as our SLO. TPOT is determined by dividing request latency by the number of generated tokens.
metric_definitions.notes: CONFLICTS with strict TPOT: divides full request latency (incl. prefill and queueing) by generated tokens, i.e. NORM_LAT-like; SLO is on per-request average TPOT

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We use tokens per dollar (T/$) to measure GPU cost efficiency, calculated by summing input and output tokens and dividing the total by the GPU's on-demand rental cost for a given time period.
metric_definitions.notes: input+output tokens; throughput measured at highest saturation where TPOT still meets SLO

metric_definitions.definition_quote: The service cost is computed by summing the hourly on-demand cloud renatl rates for each of the selected GPUs.

slo_spec: Average-TPOT SLO of 40 ms (swift services) and 120 ms (relaxed), set following standard LLM inference benchmarks and above human reading speed; attainment checked post hoc (99.5% / 99.95% of requests met)
load_regime: request-rate sweep (workload histogram over request sizes; rates 1-32 req/s) ; load balancer with weighted random routing in validation
tradeoff_acknowledged: Allocation chosen on average TPOT leaves ~0.05-0.5% of requests violating SLO; authors note services may need higher adherence. Low-end GPUs cheaper per token but need more instances at tight SLO.
hardware: NVIDIA L4, A10G, A100-80GB, H100 (cloud on-demand pricing; RunPod H100 normalized)
extractor_notes: Latency is only a constraint (average TPOT SLO), cost is the sole objective. TPOT here = request latency / generated tokens (includes prefill and queueing), not the strict decode-only TPOT. SLO is on mean per-request TPOT, not a tail percentile; attainment is measured as fraction of requests under SLO.
load_class_quote: request-rate sweep (1-32 req/s) over workload histograms of request sizes; weighted random load balancer in validation (§6)
repass_log: COST and TPOT already design; TPOT stat_basis explicit (average TPOT)
